# LocalQuantumLearningRule

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A learning algorithm that updates synaptic weights using only locally available quantum information and spike timing, without global error propagation. Enables scalable on-chip training in distributed neuromorphic systems, reducing communication overhead in TCC interconnects.
